newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures end steady in quiet trade.

text.p: Rubber futures closed mostly steady on Monday with the start of computerised order-driven trading sessions having little impact in the market, brokers said.

"There are no speculators in the market to provide liquidity to the trade and the result was that sessions were mostly dull. I tried to buy something, but I could not get anything going," one rubber trader said.
Dealers said the absence of major buyers kept trading subdued and prices range-bound. "We'll just have to see if the conditions change for the best tomorrow," another dealer said.
At around 0945 GMT, November RSS3 was seen at 127.50-129.50 U.S. cents a kg from last Friday's settlement of 128.25 U.S. cents.
November RSS1 was seen at 186.00-188.00 Singapore cents (US$1.33-$1.35) a kg against the previous 187.00 cents.
November TSR20 was seen at 176.50-178.50 Singapore cents (US$1.26-$1.27) a kg against 178.25 cents.
